Real Me wanted to shout that I’m fighting back every day… but Mom Me told him, again, that some things are sad accidents and we can learn to accept them or be upset all the time. I said the next time someone talks about my eyepatch, tell them a silly pirate joke. There's one I remembered from grade school: 'What's a pirate's favorite letter? source: “Not do it,” they say. “So dumb,” all agree. Big group: cousins and siblings clumped together with me. All hide under leaf, clumped for heat. Could freeze if not. Time of cold air. But I have question. They never question. They: eat daisies, mate, hide, sleep, eat daisies, mate, hide, sleep, on and on. Me: what there on top of mountain? “Make way,” I say and fly. I fly up and up, through many tree, wings whirr strong, follow long slope up. Only bug in air is me. I worry – what if hungry bird watches? I fly up and up. Less tree and more wind the more up I go. Wind and cold make wings harder to move, antenna lose feeling. But I see top close ahead so I push hard. Then it happen: big cold wind. Wing, front leg, middle leg, back leg – whole body stop from cold as wind carry me up and over mountain top. I am prisoner of wind but sight… amazing. I see bigness and smallness at same time, how sky and cloud go everywhere forever, how rock and tree and water share the wild ground. Beauty I not know could be. Sight blurs, body saying "I done." Ah well, nice to see a perfect thing. I wake in ground needle where wind drop me. First, excited: I alive, can tell family of the perfect! Then, sad: home… where? “Hey, ant!” I say. He stop and put down leaf in mouth, he turn to me. “I saw all of ground and sky, the bigness and smallness, was so perfect!” “So what?” he grunt, and take his leaf to eat, then mate, hide, sleep.
target: 「別去，」他們說。「笨死了，」大家都同意。 一大群，表兄弟姊妹、兄弟姊妹，跟我擠一起。全躲葉子下，擠在一起取暖。不這樣會凍死。現在是空氣冷的時候。可是我有問題。他們從來沒問題。 他們：吃雛菊，交配，躲藏，睡覺，吃雛菊，交配，躲藏，睡覺，一直重複。我：山頂上有什麼？ 「讓路，」我說，然後飛走。我往上飛，一直往上，穿過好多樹，翅膀用力振，沿著長長山坡往上。空中只有我一隻蟲。我擔心——要是有餓鳥看著呢？我還是一直往上飛。越高，樹越少，風越多。風和冷讓翅膀越來越難動，觸角沒感覺了。但我看到山頂就在前面，所以更用力。然後來了：一陣好大的冷風。 翅膀、前腳、中腳、後腳——全身凍得不能動，風把我捲上去，越過山頂。我成了風的囚犯，可眼前……太驚人。我同時看見巨大和渺小，天空和雲朵到處延伸，直到永遠，石頭、樹、水共享荒野的大地。不知道世上能有這種美。眼前模糊，身體在說：「我不行了。」啊，能看到完美的事物，真好。 我在地上的松針堆裡醒來，風把我丟在這。先是興奮：我還活著，可以告訴家人那份完美！然後難過：家……在哪？ 「喂，螞蟻！」我說。他停下，把嘴裡的葉子放下，轉向我。「我看到了整片大地和天空，巨大和渺小，真的好完美！」 「所以呢？」他咕噥，拿起葉子去吃，然後交配、躲藏、睡覺。
